feed.headline: Could you scale a recipe without a calculator?

feed.question: How many teaspoons are in one tablespoon?
No 1/4 cup measure. How many tablespoons do you use?
How many tablespoons are in 1/3 cup?

items.question: How many teaspoons are in one tablespoon?
items.why: 1 tablespoon is 3 teaspoons, or half a fluid ounce.
items.source: USDA Food Buying Guide, Volume Equivalents

items.question: No 1/4 cup measure. How many tablespoons do you use?
items.why: A quarter cup is 4 tablespoons. A full cup is 16.
items.source: USDA Food Buying Guide, Volume Equivalents

items.question: How many tablespoons are in 1/3 cup?
items.why: One third of 16 tablespoons is 5 and 1/3: that's 5 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon.
items.source: USDA Food Buying Guide, Volume Equivalents

feed.tie: Scaling a recipe? RecipeFix does the math in measurements you can actually use.
